title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
statement: Given the root of a binary search tree (BST) and an integer `k`, return the `k`th smallest value (1-indexed) of all the values of the nodes in the tree.
inputFormat:
Line 1: space-separated strings mapping the level-order traversal of the BST.
Line 2: an integer k.
outputFormat: A single integer: the kth smallest element.

starterCode.python:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
arr = lines[0].split()
k = int(lines[1])
